summary: A monthly ticketed workshop-and-open-mic hybrid produced by Story Parlor (a West Asheville performance venue) and led by a rotating certified 'Inward & Artward' Creative Facilitator, the training program run by Story Parlor's own founder Erin Hallagan Clare. The second half is an open-floor share round with a sign-up sheet at the door for whoever shows up, not a fixed membership sharing work with familiar peers.

evidence.note: Listing says 'a certified Inward & Artward Creative Facilitator leads' the workshop each month, implying the leader rotates and is a paid role, not a community organizer.

The salon half is explicitly open-floor: 'There will be a sign-up sheet at the door as you arrive; we will get through as many shares as time allows' - the same structure as an open mic, not a returning peer group.
Each month has a distinct workshop topic (Creative Constraint, Archetype/Metaphor, Feeding the Muse) with no membership, dues, or roster language anywhere in the listings.
Story Parlor presents certified Inward & Artward Creative Facilitators as a bench of trained professionals available to lead workshops - a business offering, not a self-organizing club.

Inward & Artward is Erin Hallagan Clare's creativity-coaching training program/school, confirming the Creativity Mixer is programming produced by Story Parlor's leadership rather than a member-run group.

No Facebook group, Meetup page, Discord, or newsletter specific to 'Creativity Mixer' or 'Narrative Arts Salon' turned up in search; the only community-shaped hit (a Meetup called 'Whole Creative Living Collective') appears to be an unrelated separate offering.
